newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST -London-based Arab newspapers - March 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST -London-based Arab newspapers - March 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Oman rejects Israel's participation in a water conference in Muscat on March 9.
- Dubai Aluminium company increases its production capacity by 50 percent under a new $503 million expansion project.
- Gulf Arab states' deficit expected to rise to $11.3 billion in 1997 from $10.2 billion in 1996, Emirates Industrial Bank says.
- Palestinian President Yasser Arafat asks U.S. President Bill Clinton to convince Israeli prime minister not to implement a housing plan in Jerusalem.
- Saudi Arabia and U.S. in talks on tax exemption deal.
- Sudan and Chinese firm sign deal to set up oil refinary with a 50,000 barrels per day capacity.
